trial_court: VIII Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge (CCH-15) at Bengaluru - O.S. No.6787/2022
case_name: Savithramma G Alias P Savithri vs Lakshmi Devi P

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt.G.Savithramma @ P.Savithri, W/o. Late P.Venkateswarulu, and Sri.P.V.Srinivas @ Srinivasa.V, S/o. Late P.Venkateswarulu
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt.P.Lakshmi Devi, Major, Sri.P.V.Sathish Kumar, Major, Sri.P.Subramanyam @ P.Subbarao, Major, and The Senior Divisional Security Commissioner, Railway Protection Force, South Western Railway

facts_of_case: The plaintiffs filed a suit against the defendants for declaration to declare that the plaintiff No.1 is the legally wedded wife and the plaintiff No.2 is the son of deceased P.Venkateshwarulu who was employee of the defendant No.4, and for permanent injunction restraining the defendant No.4 to disburse any amount to any person including the defendant Nos.1 to 3.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to establish a fact to prove it.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, the documentary evidence and oral testimony available before the Court is sufficient to establish that P.Venkateshwarulu married the defendant No.1 on 7.8.1987 and from that wedlock, the defendant Nos.2 and 3 were born.
cited_cases: Savithramma G Alias P Savithri vs Lakshmi Devi P (2025)

legal_principles.principle: A subsequent development can affect the validity of a marriage.
legal_principles.held: In view of this subsequent development, the parties are in dispute with regard to the validity of the marriage.
cited_cases: Savithramma G Alias P Savithri vs Lakshmi Devi P (2025)

outcome.final_order: The suit is decreed in favour of the plaintiffs.
